messages.author: c6f55d4780691300
messages.subject: Multigroup SEM: Comparing path coefficients - which satorra-bentler correction should be used?
parts:
Hi all,

after searching this group and the internet I still haven't found an answer to my question and hopefully, you might be able to help me out. 
I've set up the following multigroup SEM, which gives good fit indices. 

sem_model <- "f1 =~ indf11_z + indf12_z + indf13_z

f2 =~ indf21_z + indf22_z + indf23_z + indf24_z

f3 =~ indf31_z + indf32_z + indf33_z

f4 =~ indf41_z + indf42_z + indf43_z

f5 =~ indf51_z + indf52_z + indf53_z

f6 =~ indf61_z + indf62_z + indf63_z

f7 =~ indf71_z + indf72_z + indf73_z

f8 =~ indf81_z + indf82_z + indf83_z + indf84_z


f3 ~ f1 + f2 + f8

f4 ~ f1 + f2 + f8 

f5 ~ f1 + f2 + f8

f6 ~ F1 + f2 + f8


f3 ~~ f4 + f5 + f6

f4 ~~ f5 + f6

f5 ~~ f6


f1 ~~ f8 + f2

f2 ~~ f8


f7 ~ f2 + f1 + f8 + f3 + f4 + f5 + f6"

fit_sem_model <- sem(sem_model, data = cfa_data, group = "agegr", missing = "fiml", estimator = "MLR")


Now I want to compare path coefficients between the two groups which I do by restraining the variable of interest (see below, e.g. difference in f1 on f3):

f1_on_f3_model <- "f1 =~ indf11_z + indf12_z + indf13_z

f2 =~ indf21_z + indf22_z + indf23_z + indf24_z

f3 =~ indf31_z + indf32_z + indf33_z

f4 =~ indf41_z + indf42_z + indf43_z

f5 =~ indf51_z + indf52_z + indf53_z

f6 =~ indf61_z + indf62_z + indf63_z

f7 =~ indf71_z + indf72_z + indf73_z

f8 =~ indf81_z + indf82_z + indf83_z + indf84_z


f3 ~ c(compare, compare)*f1 + f2 + f8

f4 ~ f1 + f2 + f8 

f5 ~ f1 + f2 + f8

f6 ~ F1 + f2 + f8


f3 ~~ f4 + f5 + f6

f4 ~~ f5 + f6

f5 ~~ f6


f1 ~~ f8 + f2

f2 ~~ f8


f7 ~ f2 + f1 + f8 + f3 + f4 + f5 + f6"

fit_model_f1_on_f3 <- sem(f1_on_f3_model, data = cfa_data, group = "agegr", missing = "fiml", estimator = "MLR")

lavTestLRT(fit_sem_model, fit_model_f1_on_f3) # test for significance (satorra.bentler.2001)

lavTestLRT(fit_sem_model, fit_model_f1_on_f3, method = "satorra.bentler.2010") # test for significance in case scaling factor is negative


In some cases, the comparison works using the satorra.bentler.2001 correction, in other cases I have to use satorra.bentler.2010 as the scaling factor is negative. When I have to use satorra.bentler.2010 I sometimes get a p-value of 1, which makes me wonder if the correction has worked or this may be some sort of mistake. My second question is then, how to properly use the sb-correction (for reporting it in an article). Do I go with the 2001-version unless the scaling factor is negative in which case I use sb2010 or do i have to use one version for all comparisons due to consistency reasons (in my case this would then be sb2010)? Any advice is dearly appreciated!


Thanks, 

Eva

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Multigroup SEM: Comparing path coefficients - which satorra-bentler correction should be used?
parts: f3 ~ c(compare, compare)*f1 + f2 + f8

Careful, that comparison is only valid if the variables are on the same scale across groups. So you need to test the assumption of metric invariance first, by constraining factor loadings to equality across groups.  If that holds, then you can add the constraint to f3 ~ f1 across groups.
sometimes get a p-value of 1, which makes me wonder if the correction has worked or this may be some sort of mistake.
If you have other software (e.g., Mplus), you can compare the result to see if it is consistent.

Do I go with the 2001-version unless the scaling factor is negative in which case I use sb2010 or do i have to use one version for all comparisons due to consistency reasons (in my case this would then be sb2010)?

That would be my advice, but you can ask on SEMNET too. It is a much wider audience, and is more appropriate for posting general (i.e., not software-specific) questions.

http://www2.gsu.edu/~mkteer/semnet.html

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Postdoctoral Researcher, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
UvA web page: http://www.uva.nl/profile/t.d.jorgensen

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Multigroup SEM: Comparing path coefficients - which satorra-bentler correction should be used?
parts: I have failed to establish metric invariance on the SEM level, I only did it on the CFA level.
CFA is how you want to test it.  Once you have established (at least partial) measurement invariance, you keep those constraints in place when you add a structural model at the latent level.
